NNEW CONCEPT ENGLISHBOOK 01 / 新概念英语

BOOK ONE · LESSON 070

When were they there?

他们是什么时候在那里的？

A bilingual lesson built around 18 dated illustrations in three rows — days of the week (stationer's, greengrocer, hairdresser, butcher, grocer, dairy), dates (church, school, the office, the baker's, home, the butcher's) and months (Australia, Austria, Canada, China, Denmark, Finland) — that practise 'When were they there?' with at/on/in. Includes workbook time- and place-classification with at/on/in and was/wasn't/were/weren't dialogues, plus grammar on there was/were questions and preposition fill-ins. 以三行共18幅带日期插图为主的双语课——星期（文具店、蔬果店、理发店、肉铺、杂货店、乳品店）、日期（教堂、学校、办公室、面包店、家、肉铺）和月份（澳大利亚、奥地利、加拿大、中国、丹麦、芬兰）——练习 at/on/in 的「他们什么时候在那里？」句型。配合教材时间/地点分类（at/on/in）和 was/wasn't/were/weren't 对话练习，以及 there was/were 问句和介词填空的语法练习。

Written exercise A Complete these sentences using at, on or in.

Complete these sentences using at, on or in. 完成以下句子，用适当的介词填空。

Fill in each blank with at, on or in.

No official key is supplied; answers are constructed from standard English usage (at + time/clock, on + day/date, in + month/season/year/country) and labelled suggested.

Written exercise B Write questions and answers using we/they and at/in/on.

Write questions and answers using we/they and at/in/on. 模仿例句提问并回答，选用 we 或 they 作主语，介词可选用 at, in 或 on。

Write a question and a full answer for each set of cues, following the printed examples.

The two printed examples (Sam and Penny/the stationer's/Monday → Where were Sam and Penny on Monday? They were at the stationer's on Monday.; you and Penny/Australia/July → Where were you and Penny in July? We were in Australia in July.) are not editable. Items 1-8 follow the same pattern; the question and answer are each one field.

02

MAKE IT YOUR OWN

Practice 练习

A Prepositions of time and place — 1 (times)

Put these times (days, months, dates, years) in the correct box with on or in. 将下列表示时间的词和短语列入正确的介词栏目中。

Classify each time expression under 'on' or 'in'.

The word bank is: November 1989, August 1st, July 1st, October 26th, January, Wednesday, 1989, Tuesday, June, September, 1952, Saturday 1975, February 16th. The key lists: on → July 1st, October 26th, Saturday, February 16th, Tuesday, January; in → August, January, 1975, June, September, 1952. Each box is one answer field.

A Prepositions of time and place — 2 (places)

Put these places (countries, shops, etc.) in the correct box with at or in. 将下列表示地点的词和短语列入正确的介词栏目中。

Classify each place under 'at' or 'in'.

The word bank is: Australia, home, the baker's, China, the dairy, Canada, the hairdresser's, India, the greengrocer's, France, the office, the butcher's, Turkey, Japan. The key lists: at → the baker's, the dairy, the hairdresser's, the greengrocer's, church, the office, the butcher's, home, the stationer's; in → China, Canada, India, France, Turkey, Japan.
